verdict.rationale: Cline can execute terminal commands and react live to output from long-running dev servers/tests/deploys (cline-docs-14), and can browse the web and use screenshots to diagnose UI issues (cline-docs-1, cline-docs-18), which supports some live-debugging workflows. However there's no documented capability for attaching a debugger, reading browser console/network logs, or setting breakpoints in a running web app. Missing for 10: dedicated browser DevTools integration (console/network inspection), breakpoint/step debugging support, and independent hands-on evidence of debugging a live app.
